about: Stage 1 (real-mode enlarger) and stage 2 (balance) golden numbers of the CHB-010 intern guide §3.2, §3.3, §6.4, §6.8 and textbook §2.6–2.8, §3.6. Setup unless noted: Portra 400 on Portra Endura, TH-KG3 lamp, the database neutral pack, SPEKTRAFILM conventions (missing data opaque), D50 viewing, no flare, aim 'midgray-normalised' (the guide's computations have no aim lights), calibration 10 s, f/8, magnification 8. Points are 0.025 log H. Scene patches: grey card at log H 0, white and black at log10(ρ/0.184).
